# rms_device_tags (Resource)

Manages tag assignments for a Teltonika RMS Device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rms_device_tags" "main" {
  device_id = rms_device.main.id
  tag_ids   = [rms_tag.production.id, rms_tag.critical.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) The ID of the device.
- `tag_ids` (Set of Number) The list of tag IDs to assign to the device.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for this assignment.
